newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexico peso mixed amid high secondary int rates.
newsitem.headline: Mexico peso mixed amid high secondary int rates.

text.p: The Mexican peso was mixed at midmorning trade on Monday, with longer contracts firmer as investors switched from dollars to the local money market, dealers said.
"It will be hard for the peso to soften as long as secondary interest rates are this high," a dealer said.
The benchmark 48-hour peso and its 24-hour counterpart both stood 1.3 centavos firmer at 7.8235/7.8270 and 7.8200/7.8240 per dollar, respectively.
Same-day peso contracts had closed for the day 1.6 centavos weaker at 7.8220/7.8250 per dollar, after lining up with other contracts.
Overnight Cetes rates on the secondary market had eased 290 basis points in midmorning trade but were still well above the primary curve at 21.35 percent, dealers said.
